title: DREM: integrating resistance and domain probabilities to prioritize plant immune receptors
summary: sequence-learning results recover characterized resistance proteins and identify a specific genome-scale set of candidate noncanonical plant immune receptors; candidates remain unvalidated.
ai_technology: two sequence models (two-layer BiLSTM with additive attention), a binary resistance classifier and multi-label domain classifier, contribute to a composite confidence score.
